notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.24.6
Finder Chart can now draw sky charts: an annotated chart over the survey image, with constellations, deep-sky objects drawn to scale and star names, and a Drawn chart style that makes a full vector atlas page with SVG, PDF and PNG output, based on Jean d'Hooghvorst's Sky Chart Generator. The same chart layers can be drawn on any plate-solved image with the view's WCS button. A new setiastrosuitepro process command runs 17 processing tools from the command line, on one image, a folder or a pipeline, with the same settings as the app's shortcuts. Ctrl+Shift+P opens command search anywhere, the keyboard cheat sheet now lists every shortcut, Robotic Mosaic corrects each frame with SRGC, and SyQon Studio receives your image unaltered. Fixes include occasional mirrored plate solutions, Finder Chart survey mirrors, crops of plate-solved images on mirrored optics, and worker processes failing with numpy 2.4. See the release notes for the full list.
